start: Settings of a gym with the member app on

steps.action: Change the box 'Gym name' (or 'Branch name' in a gym with branches)
user_sees: The new name in the box, with its hint line
must_not: The name saved before Save is tapped

user_sees: The new name at the top of the admin app
must_not: 'Saved.' when the server refused the name
The join code changed by a rename
Phone, address, GSTIN or UPI ID changed by the rename

steps.action: Open the member app on a phone that joined the gym
user_sees: The new gym name, after the app next checks
must_not: The old name left for good

steps.action: Clear the name and tap 'Save details'
user_sees: 'Type the gym’s name.' on the name box
must_not: The members’ app showing a blank gym name

steps.action: Type a new name and tap 'Save details' with the internet off
user_sees: An error banner in plain words
The new name stays in the box so it can be saved again
must_not: The admin app showing the new name while members still see the old one, with no warning

steps.action: Sign in as staff and open Settings
user_sees: The staff settings page, with no gym name box
must_not: Staff able to rename the gym

start: Settings, a gym renamed once already

steps.action: Tap 'Save details' again without changing the name
user_sees: No rename sent for the same name
must_not: An error for an unchanged name

steps.action: Rename back to the first name and save
must_not: Two names in use on different screens

steps.action: Rename in one browser, then open the admin app on a second signed-in device
user_sees: The new name on the second device after it opens
must_not: The second device saving the old name back over the new one

steps.action: Look at where the name shows
user_sees: Members of this gym see it in the app; it is on the invite poster and the join page
Only the owner can change it
must_not: Staff or a member able to change the name
The old name kept on receipts already issued being rewritten without a word
